mapper.update: MERGE INTO TB_DEPT T USING (SELECT #{deptCd} AS DEPT_CD FROM DUAL) S ON (T.DEPT_CD = S.DEPT_CD) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET T.DEPT_NM = #{deptNm}, T.UP_DEPT_CD = #{upDeptCd}, T.USE_YN = #{useYn} WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (DEPT_CD, DEPT_NM, UP_DEPT_CD, SORT_ORD, USE_YN) VALUES (#{deptCd}, #{deptNm}, #{upDeptCd}, 99, #{useYn})
